description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” (orange bars)—across eight different datasets and evaluation metrics, with scores expressed as percentages on the vertical axis ranging from 0 to 80. The horizontal axis lists the benchmarks in the following order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. For most benchmarks, the orange “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” bars are equal to or slightly higher than the blue LLaMA-3-8B-it bars, with notable exceptions: on GSM-8K, both models score nearly identically around 80%; on TruthfulQA, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~45% while “Ours” scores ~60%; on LC AlpacaEval2, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~23% and “Ours” ~32%; and on Chat-Arena-Hard, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~20% while “Ours” scores ~30%. The legend in the top-right corner clearly distinguishes the two models by color. The chart visually emphasizes that the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model generally outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it across most evaluated benchmarks, particularly on more challenging or practical tasks like TruthfulQA, LC AlpacaEval2, and Chat-Arena-Hard.
